name: D Maris Bay
insider_take: Tucked into a secluded cove on the wild Datça Peninsula, D Maris Bay feels like your own private slice of the Aegean — dramatic cliffs, crystalline turquoise waters, and a level of exclusivity that's hard to match anywhere in Turkey.
whats_special: D Maris Bay sits on one of the most unspoiled stretches of the Turkish Riviera, surrounded by pine forests and hidden coves accessible only by sea. As part of The Signature Collection, the resort delivers an ultra-luxurious all-inclusive experience with multiple private beaches, world-class dining, and its legendary Beach Club — a destination in itself that draws international jet-setters each summer. The Datça Peninsula, where the Aegean and Mediterranean Seas meet, is one of Turkey's protected natural areas, meaning the landscape around you is remarkably pristine.
pro_tip: Book a boat excursion directly from the resort to explore the ancient ruins of Knidos, a fascinating Greek-era city perched at the very tip of the Datça Peninsula — just a short cruise away and well worth the trip.
dont_miss: Don't miss the resort's signature Beach Club events, the farm-to-table dining experiences featuring fresh Aegean produce, or a sunset cocktail overlooking the glittering bay — the views at dusk here are simply unforgettable.
pros: Stunning private bay setting with crystal-clear Aegean waters and direct beach access
World-class dining with multiple restaurants showcasing fresh Mediterranean and Turkish cuisine
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities offering holistic treatments with panoramic sea views
Luxurious accommodations with private terraces or balconies overlooking the breathtaking bay
Wide array of water sports and activities including sailing, diving, and yacht excursions
cons: Secluded hillside location may require use of resort shuttles to navigate the expansive property
Premium luxury pricing places it at the higher end of the Marmaris resort market
